title: Note-Taking Application
description: An application designed for users to create, manage, and organize notes efficiently.

features.name: Create Notes
features.description: Allows users to create and save text-based notes.

features.name: Edit Notes
features.description: Enables users to modify existing notes.

features.name: Delete Notes
features.description: Provides functionality to delete notes that are no longer needed.

features.name: Organize Notes
features.description: Allows users to categorize or tag notes for better organization.

target_users: Individuals looking for a simple tool to manage their notes.
data_requirements: Requires storage for saving and retrieving user notes.
